name: tm-188-motion-presence
description: TM-188 motion-presence regression corpus — prompts historically prone to producing STATIC output (no per-frame motion). Extends the TM-149/TM-173 character/横スクロール regressions with explicit motion axes: living-entity locomotion,横스크롤 parallax, data-viz animation, transitions, periodic loaders. Each entry is measured by the TM-184 liveness gate (AST + render-diff). Frozen 2026-06-05. Categories map to the prompt-corpus loader axes; motionSubtype is the TM-188-specific motion axis. seed: deterministic — no live model call needed to enumerate the corpus.
